scripts.install:ci: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm exec --prefix backend -- eslint --config backend/eslint.config.js shared --max-warnings 0
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix frontend && npm exec --prefix frontend -- prettier --config frontend/.prettierrc.json --check backend shared README.md docs/phase-5-step-2a.md docs/phase-5-step-2b.md .github/workflows/verify.yml package.json
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.verify:fast: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run audit:prod
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run verify:mongo
scripts.verify:clean: npm run install:ci && npm run verify
